_comment: Reviewed synonym merges (same arity and argument order). Applied with: npm run consolidate -- --plan metadata/consolidation-plans/01-synonyms.json

groups.rationale: Both relate a person to an institution where they studied, with the same argument order.
Both relate a person to an institution where they taught, with the same argument order.
Both relate a person to an organisation they worked for; employed_by is the established name with more facts.
Both record a work's running time in minutes.
All relate a work to the person who made its music or soundtrack.
Both relate a work to the broadcaster or channel that transmitted it.
Both relate a work to a location where its footage was filmed.
Both relate an installation work to the place where it was installed.
All relate a recipient to an organisation that funded it, in the same argument order.
Both relate an artist to a person whose work influenced or inspired them.
Both relate a performer to a work they performed in.
invited_by's second argument is already the event a person was invited to, as in invited_to.
Both relate an organisation's earlier form to its later name, in the same argument order.
All relate a person to an organisation, project, programme or activity they took part in.
Both relate a writer to a publication they wrote for.
Both relate a work or artist to a publication that reviewed or discussed it.
Both relate a person to an organisation they approached with a proposal.
Both relate a work to the institution or place where it was made.
All relate a work or artist to a venue or exhibition where work was shown, in the same argument order.
